reproduction.rationale: Both paper_data and paper_data_author_code must use the same original 65-participant CTF TDE-HMM/TDE-DyNeMo network cohort, source preparation, split, observations, full branch-specific granular outputs and resources, with only authenticated historical author source added. Preserve participant order and demographics joins, within-branch best-of-ten selection in each of three independent optimization sets with all attempted runs, full state/mode, spectral/spatial, participant-dynamics and literal group outputs, and independent-fit correspondence; HMM and DyNeMo objectives remain distinct and are not pooled. No complete authentic CTF input and execution manifest, exposure proof, independent submitted computation and granular-output verifier or cumulative paired budgets are qualified. Reproduction additionally needs original source reference values/arrays, full-field equivalence criteria and source-parity resolution for the selected CTF network and independent-fit panels, including literal age-label semantics and the Figure5AIII concatenated-correlation versus mean participant-correlation discrepancy; fixed-fit audit is not independent reproduction. Broader Elekta/static/burst analyses and Figures7-12 remain separately scoped source evidence, not automatic primary gates. Scientific pairing qualification is separate from selector and canonical-identity binding; binding metadata alone is not an execution receipt.
